facts.business: Balaji Telefilms Limited is a media and entertainment company engaged in television production, motion pictures, and digital content creation across platforms.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Over the next two to three years, the Company expects its business mix to shift meaningfully — evolving from a television production house into an intellectual-property-led content creator, with Motion Pictures expected to become a large contributor to topline and profitability (driven by a 17-film, three-year slate and a de-risked, pre-sales-led model), followed by the digital business, while television remains an important backbone.
guidance_or_targets.value: Motion Pictures to become large contributor to topline and profitability

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company expects FY 2026-27 to be a year of execution, improved content monetisation and gradual business normalisation across segments, starting from the first quarter.
guidance_or_targets.value: Execution, improved content monetisation and gradual business normalisation

key_risks: Continued pressure on traditional TV economics
Outlook of future profitability or weaker market conditions
facts.related_party_note: Loans given to subsidiaries are towards working capital requirement and repayable on demand. Loans given to KMP and professional staff are for personal financial needs and repayable as per agreed terms. Security deposits of Rs 59.06 lacs given to three directors for properties taken on lease. Transactions with promoter group entities including Tusshar Infra Developers Private Limited and Pantheon Buildcon Private Limited.
